mapper.sql: id, department_id, position_id, company_user_id, name, phone, email, hire_date, resignation_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (department_id, position_id, company_user_id, name, phone, email, hire_date, resignation_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{companyUserId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{hireDate}, #{resignationDate}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET department_id = #{departmentId}, position_id = #{positionId}, company_user_id = #{companyUserId}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, resignation_date = #{resignationDate}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
